thread:
sarah.sales: Heads-up — Lagoon (large retail) just signaled they need exec signoff to proceed with the POC. CISO wants a short note on KMS integration, egress rules, and a committed 99.9% latency SLO before legal will greenlight.
mike.sre: Ack. We already have a Dedicated plan quote in place. The KMS ask is BYO and they want an attestation for key wrapping. Is that accurate?
anya.ops: Correct — they want keys in their KMS (Azure Key Vault). We'll need to confirm support for external KMS and provide an integration runbook + network diagram.
lucas.legal: Also asked about data residency and contract language for key custody. If we can confirm BYO KMS and an SLA, legal can fast-track review. They want a timeline today.
sarah.sales: Timeline = asap. Customer is asking for a one-week POC kickoff. They're pushing for an exec intro to get legal to prioritize.
raj.eng: Technically BYO KMS is supported but requires a private deployment or VPC peering; hosted tenants don't allow customer-managed keys yet. We can propose a Dedicated instance with peering + BYO KMS. Latency SLO depends on GPU pool sizing — need committed capacity to hit 99.9% at their QPS.
mike.sre: I'll sketch options: (A) Dedicated w/ peering + BYO KMS (meets cust asks, longer setup ~7-10 business days), (B) Hosted w/ encrypted-at-rest and RBAC + limited attestation (faster, but not BYO).
anya.ops: +1. Also need to know their expected peak RPS and sequence lengths so we can size the pool. Sarah, can you confirm expected concurrency?
sarah.sales: They said ~120 qps peak, avg prompt 350 tokens, bursty during checkout windows. They want a 2-week POC with production-like traffic.
raj.eng: 120 qps with 350 tokens avg — that's heavy. For 99.9% latency under 500ms, we'd need reserved GPUs and prewarmed instances. Estimate: 6x A100-equivalent GPUs for dedicated pool. I'll put a costs estimate in a follow-up.
lucas.legal: For contract language, we need: scope of BYO KMS (who controls keys), incident response obligations, and data deletion assurances after POC. If you can share the network diagram and KMS flow, we can draft an addendum.
sarah.sales: Customer also asked about egress — they want assurance that logs and metrics don't leave EU region. They flagged compliance for their audit. Can we confirm region isolation on Dedicated?
mike.sre: Dedicated can be provisioned in EU region and we can restrict telemetry export. We'll need to toggle retention/ingestion endpoints. I'll confirm config knobs and share a checklist.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: Dedicated pool provisioning template v2 is available at https://redwood.example/internal/dedicated-template — create request with `region: eu-west-1`, `kms: external`.
anya.ops: Action items: 1) raj to send sizing + rough cost (by EOD) 2) mike to confirm telemetry/egress controls + runbook (by EOD) 3) lucas to draft KMS addendum checklist (tomorrow morning) 4) sarah to confirm customer concurrency and push for exec intro (today)
sarah.sales: I'll ping their VP of infra for an intro and attach our requirements doc.
raj.eng: Cost note: provisional estimate ~ $18k/month for reserved capacity + onboarding. Will break down in the note. If they only want a short POC (2 weeks), we can do a time-limited discount of 50% for the trial.
mike.sre: If they accept Dedicated we can do a hardened runbook and a guided 3-day cutover during POC. I'll include runbook snippets like:
```
- VPN tunnel config
- IP allowlist ranges
- KMS handshake steps
- Test plan: 1000 synthetic requests over 10m window
```
sarah.sales: Perfect. Can we get a one-pager for execs that summarizes asks + blockers? I need something to drop on the VP call in 30m.
anya.ops: I'll assemble a one-pager now. Will include bullets: BYO KMS = Dedicated required, estimated lead time 7-10d, cost estimate, egress/residency controls, legal addendum required.
lucas.legal: I'll standby to review the one-pager. If it looks good I'll escalate to our VP Legal for priority review.
sarah.sales: Thanks team. @mike.sre @raj.eng please mark any absolute no-go items; otherwise I'll take this to the customer call.
raj.eng: No hard no-gos. Main risk = timing for Dedicated provisioning. If they need <3 days, we can't meet BYO KMS requirement.
mike.sre: Also ensure the customer can accept a temporary maintenance window for the peering change. I'll note that.
sarah.sales: Ok call in 25. Sharing the one-pager when it's ready. :thumbsup:
anya.ops: One-pager uploaded: https://redwood.example/drive/lagoon-poc-exec-1pager.pdf
lucas.legal: Reviewing now. If minor edits, will return within 2 hours.
sarah.sales: Update from customer mid-call: they're open to a hybrid — start hosted POC to prove model quality, then escalate to Dedicated if security gating fails. That could shorten timelines.
raj.eng: Hybrid is doable. We'll prepare a checklist for migrating from hosted to dedicated mid-POC.
mike.sre: Great. I'll also prepare an abbreviated attestation for hosted that covers encryption-in-transit/rest and RBAC controls — might satisfy their immediate Legal comfort.
sarah.sales: Thanks all. I'll post follow-ups here after exec intro.
